body.construction: \(\mathfrak M^{\mathrm{CY},0}=\{(P_n)_{n\ge1}:\mathsf A_{\mathrm{ind}}((P_n))\wedge\mathsf A_{\mathrm{ctr}}((P_n))\wedge\mathsf A_{\mathrm{subG}}((P_n))\wedge\mathsf A_{\mathrm{var}}((P_n))\wedge\mathsf A_{\mathrm{rowvar}}((P_n))\wedge\mathsf A_{\mathrm{vrep}}((P_n);\varepsilon^{\mathrm{vrep}})\wedge\mathsf A_{R=0}((P_n))\wedge\mathsf A_{\mathrm{fact}}((P_n))\wedge\mathsf A_{\mathrm{rank}}((P_n))\wedge\mathsf A_{\mathrm{inc}}((P_n))\wedge\mathsf A_{\mathrm{sig}}((P_n);\varepsilon^{\mathrm{sig}})\wedge\mathsf A_{\mathrm{spec}}((P_n);\varepsilon^{\mathrm{spec}})\wedge\mathsf A_{\mathrm{block}}((P_n);\varepsilon^{\mathrm{block}})\wedge\mathsf A_A((P_n))\wedge\mathsf A_B((P_n))\wedge\mathsf A_{\mathrm{nd}}((P_n))\wedge\mathsf A_{\mathrm{lev}}((P_n);\varepsilon^{\mathrm{lev}})\}\).  Every member property holds at each finite \(n\) with the single constants \(C_e,\underline\sigma,\bar\sigma,\bar\mu,c_A,C_A,c_B,C_B\) and the fixed envelopes displayed in the symbol table.  This is the note's baseline event-transfer class; it is not the class asserted in Choi--Yuan's published theorem.
